sources.notes: Aesthetic input, never factual authority. Original sheet panel A supplies faceting, airy crown and warm trunk, but its thick repeatedly divided modern-tree boughs are NOT anatomical authority. Replace with slender lateral digitate branch sprays inserted along upper trunk, which continues unbranched to a domed apex. Approximate 6 vertical insertion ranks, 3 uneven levels, each primary branch divides distally into 3-5 finger-like axes carrying terminal dichotomous twigs. Narrow lower trunk, flared basal foot with slender non-branching roots, not oak buttresses. 18 sprays artistic simplification; no leaves/fronds/sporangia modeled, no exact crown density or internal hollow-trunk claim.
